zoe (marketing): Quick sync  targeting announce week of May 4. Need final changelog link, canonical docs URL, and a 1-line benchmark for the blog. :calendar:

rahul (eng): changelog PR is up: https://git.internal/redwood/changelog/pulls/1203. Small opt-in API: `routing_policy`. Default behavior unchanged.

kelly (docs): I can draft the docs page. Please paste the minimal request example and a short migration note for pinned models.

rahul (eng): sample to include in docs:
POST /v1/infer
{ "model": "rwd-adaptive-v1", "routing_policy": { "type": "hybrid", "max_latency_ms": 110 } }
Migration note: customers who pin `rwd-standard` will keep previous routing; remove the pin or set `routing_policy` to opt in.

sam (ops): Deploy plan: canary us-west-2 2% for 3h, then 25% global ramp if healthy. We can schedule docs to publish at canary start. Deploy scheduled 2026-05-03T22:00:00Z.

zoe (marketing): Need a one-line bench for the banner (p95 + cost delta) and a short paragraph for the blog.

rahul (eng): internal perf (10k reqs, seq=128): p95 baseline 125ms -> adaptive 104ms (~17%), estimated token cost delta -12%. I'll add full test notes to the PR.

leo (sales): Sales needs SFDC tag for webinar signups and early access requests. Can ops add a hidden field/hook to auto-tag?

sam (ops): Yes  OPS ticket #631 to add an 'early_access' flag and webhook to SFDC.

zoe (marketing): Great. I'll draft the banner + 3 social posts. Please react with :eyes: when changelog/docs PRs are merged so I can lock copy.

deploy-bot: Deploy #deploy-177777 scheduled for 2026-05-03T22:00:00Z. Canary queued: us-west-2 2% 3h.
